descriptionHtml:
Case priority: P0 · stated in the UAT / ticket AC · TFA-92588 AC 1 + AC 10 · “Pre-round tasks appear in the task list”.

Bug N27 · S1 · new

A dictated medication list sentence that contains one 'as needed' drug adds none of its drugs to Medications or the tracker

Tickets: TFA-92588 AC 9, TFA-92597 · counts as a QA bug: yes · found on: dev + local (43c38a4f)

Note: Local and dev; control 7 of 7 vs 0 of 7 (rcMedConditionalOnly is sentence-scoped).

Approach · TC-10 Pre-Rounding Summary · S28 A 1,500-character Hospital pre-round: every lab, medication and study is kept, and plan items after character 1,200 still become tasks

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U2 Save Note turns the input into the prototype's summary shape: first a Background (a one-liner with age, sex, reason for admission and significant PMH woven in, then active-issue bullets), then vitals … (UAT TC-10; TFA-92588 AC 1; TFA-92588 How it works 3) — gate: blocked: TFA-92588 ready for pr
  • U8 Pre-round tasks (the plan items) appear in the task list. (UAT TC-10; TFA-92588 AC 10; TFA-92588 How it works 4) — gate: blocked: TFA-92588 ready for pr

Test design technique: Boundary values (boundary) — Sit right on the edge of the rule (exactly on time / a minute late, empty, longest, most) and see on which side the behavior changes.

Given The make-session Hospital patient (Community-acquired pneumonia), nothing else on file

When Type the long text below into the pre-round box, Save Note, look at the Pre-Round panels, then the Encounter tab's Tasks

Then Labs hold all 12 labs, Medications all 7 drugs with their doses, Diagnostic Testing all 3 studies; no panel shows its empty state except Vitals; the two plan items at the end (ask ID about removing the PICC line, a repeat echocardiogram for Friday) are tasks

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): scripts/oracle.mjs: lab names and decimal values, drug names with doses, study words, and the two plan items on the Tasks list. Code read predicts cp2 Fails: usePreRoundProcess.ts sends input.trim().substring(0, 1200) to extractTasks, and the plan starts at character 1404. …

Where it ran: local newspec-c (new Playwright specs); test method AGENT · Browser agent; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (automated)

S28 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-10.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 0 rows.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 8b4be94a (10-20), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane newspec-c.

Test method: AGENT · Browser agent; secondary: CODEREVIEW · Code review — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: newspec-c.

UAT item: TC-10 Pre-Rounding Summary · Section: A2 · Pre-Round · Scenario: TC-10/S28

A 1,500-character Hospital pre-round: every lab, medication and study is kept, and plan items after character 1,200 still become tasks

Tickets: TFA-92588 Pre-Rounding Summary (ready for qa)

New local lane newspec-c: status failed in newspec-c/results.json → failed · product (failed · product (the lane flagged a product issue)).

Detail:

Local QA stack on main 43c38a4f (round-companion-wt-qa, web :6473, Convex :4510); fresh @roundai.test physician per test; every ai/* action the page sent was answered or refused at the browser socket (pre-support.ts aiSocket: anything unscripted is refused), so no model ran; tripwire around every batch: 'no model call'. Spec newspec-c/pre-tc10-s28-long.spec.ts: every model call answered as a perfect model would (the summary returns all 12 labs, 7 drugs with doses and 3 studies; task extraction returns one task per plan item present in the text it was sent), so anything missing was lost by the app. Judged 2/5: Labs holds all 12 labs with values; Diagnostic Testing holds all 3 studies. Failed: (1) Medications stays 'No medications recorded yet.' — none of the 7 drugs is written; (2)+(3) neither plan item ('ask infectious disease about removing the PICC line', 'book a repeat echocardiogram for Friday') becomes a task. Causes, both in the client: (2)+(3) usePreRoundProcess.ts sends input.trim().substring(0, 1200) to ai/parsing:extractTasks — the request carried 1,200 of 1,507 characters, ending '…The PICC site was clean this morning with no', and the plan starts at character 1,404 (code read predicted this); (1) the pre-round medication merge drops a new row whose drug is 'mentioned only conditionally' (src/domain/medicationGuard.ts rcMedConditionalOnly), testing the whole sentence against RC_MODAL_RE, which includes 'as needed'; S28 dictates all 7 drugs in one sentence ending 'and acetaminophen 650 mg every 6 hours as needed', so every drug in it is dropped. Control (newspec-c/pre-tc10-s28-prn-control.spec.ts, recorded): the same 7 returned drugs give 0 rows with that sentence, 7 rows without 'as needed', 6 rows with the PRN drug in a sentence of its own (the PRN drug itself is never added). Whether a live model extracts all 12 labs, 7 drugs and 3 studies is AI: dev TC-10/S28.

Product issue: (1) A medication list dictated in one sentence that includes one 'as needed' drug (here '…and acetaminophen 650 mg every 6 hours as needed.') puts none of its drugs on the Medications panel or the tracker after Save Note — scheduled ceftriaxone, azithromycin, enoxaparin, pantoprazole, metoprolol and atorvastatin all vanish. (2) In a pre-round longer than 1,200 characters, plan items after character 1,200 never become tasks (only the first 1,200 characters are sent to task extraction).

Evidence: 6 attached.

Dev run: skipped: ticket-gate — ticket-gate: TFA-92588 ready for pr — requirements U2, U8 gated (runnable on dev otherwise). This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).

This case has results elsewhere too (a case shows one result: a verdict beats blocked, a run beats a skip; within a tier the worse one, on a tie the earlier one (dev, dev lanes, local lane A/C, new local lanes), test out of date ranks above passed; when all are skips the dev one, unless dev only says "local only / can't run on dev" or gives the lane's own reason):

  • [dev newspec-c] failed (newspec-c/results.json) — newspec-c: failed → failed (failed (the lane flagged no product issue)) Dev (main 8b4be94a, deployed 2026-10-20 02:04 JST), live models, under runs/.dev.lock; only prefixed rows created and all deleted (0 remaining, 0 changes to other rows).
